info.schedule: Online, usually a minimum-bid round in July or August and a no-reserve round in the fall
info.note: Catalogs, inspector notes, photos and results come from Title Check's tax-sale.info, which runs the auctions for most Michigan treasurers. County value is twice the State Equalized Value (SEV), since Michigan sets SEV at half of market value.

Located just SE of Marquette in the Lakewood neighborhood. Midcentury ranch with some potential for the handyman. Has the blue-tarp-roofing indicator that suggests its time for a refresh. We are told that some of the ceiling inside has fallen in from leakage. The yard and home are trash strewn. Noticeable maintenance issues apparent here. This property is still occupied as of early June, and he ma...

40' x 307' vacant lot. 1/4 acre. This parcel appears to be the location of the septic system for the house on the adjacent property at 45141 CR 581. This parcel has no road frontage or legal access. It should be owned by the property owner of the house which may be unoccupied presently.

The Mighty Michigamme is one of he UP's great rivers. This 1/2 acre parcel has 76' of frontage as includes an older mobile home. The mobile appears to have been last occupied about 2017 based on dated items we see inside. There are minor roof leaks beginning in a few spots that are not yet advanced, but we'd get a roof patch underway quickly before it does. The mobile is basically clean and solid....
Single platted lot in Republic. We suspect it has never had anything on it in the past as it is fully wooded. ~0.17 Acres.

Located south of Palmer in RIchmond Township. Older roofover mobile home on a nicely wooded 2.5 acre parcel Exterior porches are in disrepair and the roofs and decking need repair. Was likely a well cared for property in the past but has been vacant for a while. Inside there is a little accumulation to dispose of, but other than being a little musty, this one won't take a ton of work to bring back...

Parcel is surrounded with wood stockade fence that is in disrepair. Older single wide mobile that has seen better days. Several inoperable vehicles.  The trailer has had the exterior siding panels harvested, and the wood frame is pretty well collapsed. The value here is in the land, well, septic, power and other infrastructure, tho we cannot be certain of their condition. A couple miles from the S...

This is a 1.5 story wood frame home in central Ishpeming, just north of downtown. Low maintenance exterior and attached one car garage, which still houses an abandoned vehicle. The inside is cluttered with debris making the condition difficult to assess, but the house appears to be straight and solid. It exhibits indicators that it was likely well cared for during most of its life. It is a mid-cen...

Mid-century updated two story wood frame home in Ishpeming. Overlooks Lake Bacon. Like many others we see, it is difficult to really describe the condition of this one because of the sheer volume of debris inside. The clutter here is of the "good" (non-stinky) kind and includes a lot of clothing, books, household items and furniture. So it won't be as nasty to clean as others. But until it is empt...
Vacant, level, open lot in Ishpeming. Located on Greenwood Street across from the Insight fuel station. Appears that a structure has been removed from this property in recent years. ~0.16 Acre.

Parcel is about 9500 square feet in size. You'll want to check with the zoning folks about minimum size requirements if you're considering building here. Nice quiet Ishpeming neighborhood.~0.20 Acres.
Single, platted vacant SWAMPLOT in Republic. If this area has zoning, this is too small for new construction and best if owned by a neighbor.

This is the former Ruusivivian Oil Co property in the SW corner of Ishpeming. This sale includes only the decaying green block building and the vacant lot to the west of it. The bulk fuel dock to the rear is not a part of this parcel. The building shows strong indication of oil and gasoline contamination on walls and floors, and the roof has caved in ... there is a hole in the roof big enough to d...

Somewhat rectangular, but irregular in shape. 175' or so on the road and maybe 150' deep. The surface includes some large rock formation, which is common in this area. Sits about five feet above road grade

Grandma and Grampa house. Clean, and unmolested interior pine trim and maple floors. A traditional, classic modified four-square home updated with wide vinyl siding and a newer shingle roof. This home has been unoccupied for a little while but is still so clean you could move right in. There is personal property here that belongs to the heirs (see notes). A newer natural gas boiler and water heate...

Older wood frame home that clearly needs some work, and a collapsed garage type building at the roadside. There are broken windows and rot in wood elements present. The property does not have electric seride at this time. The occupant uses the parcel for a sawmill and shop. It is occupied, so we did not have the opportunity to view it in detail. Has an older shingle roof in poor condition with loc...

This is a vacant lot west of, and two vacant lots behind, the Champion Apostolic Lutheran Church. The parcels adjoin and total 1.6 acres. the parcel west of the church may have contained a house at one time, and is a rock plateau that sits about 5 feet above road grade. The two lots to the rear of the church have no direct street access, which is why they are included with the lot to the west. Our...

Older two story home in Champion. Appears to have been vacant since 2022. A couple of inoperable/unlicensed vehicles in the front yard, and several outbuildings and an assortment of debris out back. The house needs a roof, particularly over the rear one story portion which has been leaking for some time. The two story section appears to be in better condition, but it all needs to be replaced. Ther...

Not much here worth saving except the land. Would make a nice addition to an adjoining lot of the house were removed. Structure has a collapsing roof over the rear section, collapsing foundation under all of it, and is full of waterlogged goodies. There is a shared driveway of sorts along the boundary with the parcel to the west that the neighbor mows.

Late century stick built house near Champion in the Snowville location. Has been left full of stinky garbage and rummage sale grade castoff. Could be a decent place after removing a couple three dumpster loads. Has a newer roof with a couple of loose shingles. We saw leakage in the kitchen around the skylight. 3BR 2BA. Some of the thermalpane windows have broken seals and will need replacement. Th...

Wooded parcel. Fronts on E Provost Lake Road in Forsyth Township, south of Gwinn. The parcel lies on BOTH sides of E Provost Lake Road where it runs west from its intersection with Sporley Lake Drive. It can be thought of as not one ... not two ... but THREE parcels, as there is another chunk that lies the west of where Provost Lake Road forks to the north and south. This is very level, sandy, wel...

Triangular parcel has about 120' on E Millyard Road. Open land. There is a trail that runs from the north point of this property to the SW that is the western boundary. Included in this sale is a large hole in the ground for you to throw all of your money into, in case you've been looking for one of those.  Might have been the start of a septic system ??

One acre parcel, irregular in shape. Sits along the east side of N Brook Lane, which runs SE from N Lobb Avenue ... just NW of Gwinn in Forsyth Township. The property runs east to a small brook/creek. This may be a private road and not county maintained. You'll want to check on that if it is important to you. The parcel sits about five feet above grade at the roadside, and rolls slightly downhill ...

Parcel is irregular in shape, somewhat like a slice of Banana cream pie.  Only fronts about 25' feet along E Johnson Lake Road. Roughly 1.38 acres in total. Was owned by a neighbor that decided they didn't need it anymore. Known as "Parcel B" in a survey of the area. Level, wooded property with well drained sandy soils. Power at the road. I'll bet you want some banana cream pie now, don't you ? If...

Older two story wood frame home in a very nice neighborhood in Gwinn. It is difficult to ascertain the exact condition of this building, because it is about chest deep in garbage. Some of it is clothing and such, but there is food garbage mixed in here also. Has a bad roof, and there are some areas of rot in the trim as well. Vinyl sided, so you can't really tell what it's like underneath. We coul...

Parcel is 32.5 acres in size. Is has no improved road access, but can be accessed by trails off seasonal two track roads. It is unclear if that access is deeded legal access or restricted,. The property is predominately marshland according to USGS topographical maps. There is no electric service in this area. Recreational property ? Hunt camp ? You decide .... Two adjacent parcels in this sale. We are told that this one may be contested before the auction. It is currently vacant, but the former owner is local and still watching, so exercise caution if visiting.  The house is surrounded on two sides by a privacy fence that encloses an above-ground pool. Newer steel roof and vinyl siding for low maintenance. The interior is pleasant and fairly clean with ...

Modern raised ranch stick built home and detached two car garage. On a corner lot about 7 miles north of 41/28 and NE of Negaunee. This property was occupied at the time of our visit in early June, so we did not have the opportunity to view it in detail. It appears to have an older roof and be in need of general exterior maintenance. It is a bit brushy, and overgrown. There are several vehicles in...

We see lots of places just loaded to the brim with trash. This isn't one of em. They pretty much took everything except maybe a pickup load when they left. So the intake won't be too difficult. One bedroom, rustic pine interior and a detached two car garage on a 1 acre corner lot. Roof is in good condition. LP gas forced air heat. Living room thermalpane glass seal is broken and it's clouded up. W...

This home was occupied at the time of our visit in early June. There is noticeable accumulation in the yard. This is a 17 acre parcel that has at least 4 buildings and a couple of mobile homes (or parts of mobile homes) in various states of disrepair. At least two or three of the structures are collapsed. It's difficult to determine exactly what is here, as the property is still occupied and not a...
Single, platted vacant SWAMPLOT in Republic. If this area has zoning, this is too small for new construction and best if owned by a neighbor.

Older multi-level wood frame home in Palmer near the Tilden Mine. Has had some rough use. Boarded windows from vandalism. Overall this was a pretty decent little place, until it was destroyed in a fit of rage. Newer roof, vinyl sided for low maintenance. This place is much larger than it appears from the exterior. We counted space on 4 different levels plus the garage. We think we saw 4 bedrooms a...

2 story home on the SE corner of Ishpeming. Could certainly use some help, but restorable. Maple floors. It's grungy and dirty and smells like Pall Malls, but overall it is straight with one BIG caveat. The stairway to the basement (from inside a rear addition) has a collapsed foundation wall. We could not really get into the basement because of the amount of debris here, and we could not complete...

2 story, wood frame home in the Frenchtown location SW of Ishpeming. This property was still occupied as of the time of our visit in early June, so we did not have the opportunity to inspect it in detail. From the curbside, the exterior is a little weather-beaten. Wood frame construction with low maintenance vinyl siding and a steel roof. Attached one car garage to the front left side. Home was still occupied at the time of our visit in early June, so we did not have the opportunity to review it in detail. Paved county road. Some clutter and deferred maintenance. Merchantable with a little work from exterior observation.
